messages.body: staff-reviewer done: rejected 1/2 (F1 critical: parse/writer ignore schema; F2, F3 minor). alock refused pull-requests.md (held by openlanes:43808), so findings are in PR #210 comment 6844083710 only.
staff-reviewer rerun: PR #210 head still 30537b23, so my round-1 verdict stands (rejected 1/2, comment 6844083710). pull-requests.md is still locked by openlanes:55939, so my findings are not in it.

entries.text: depends_on: [none]. 057 builds nothing it waits for; 058 depends on 057, not the other way round
json_schemer moves from the Gemfile's test group to a gemspec runtime dependency, because Config.parse validates at runtime
The commands schema is built from the dry-cli registry when the schema loads; the checked-in file is regenerated by just update-config-schema and a spec fails when it is stale
execution: concurrent. The spec is not a refactor
The plan folder was locked by the harness itself (openlanes pid 70038, intent 'planner on 057.00'), so I wrote under that lock and did not take my own
plan.md written with 6 back-end units (U1-U6), no front end, no HTTP surface; signed Completed with --next backend-coder

U5: Project.main_checkout/enter_main_checkout/primary_of; Start#call enters main checkout first and prints one STDERR line; Allocator primary reuses Project.primary_of. Real git worktree specs in start_spec and project_spec.

U1: schemas/openlanes-config.schema.json (merged, commands included) + Config::Schema (document, keys, keys_for, defaults, errors, write, jsonable for Date/Symbol). schema_spec covers keys == KEYS/*_KEYS, leaves have description+default, freshness.

U2: Config::CommandsSchema.build(registry) walks dry-cli @root nodes; uses option.options[:desc] because #desc appends values. String flags typed [string, number] so commands.run.timeout: 1800 stays valid.
json_schemer moved from the Gemfile :test group to a gemspec runtime dependency. Rubocop -a on Gemfile/gemspec reorders unrelated gems, so never autocorrect those two files.

U3: derive KEYS and *_KEYS from Schema without changing the 'known:' order (schema lists commands last, KEYS has it after merge); run Schema.errors after the hand checks and map them to '<path>: <key>: <problem>'; add the just update-config-schema recipe.

U4: to_yaml writes every key, filling from Schema.defaults, and init writes the whole file. U6: integration spec. Then contract.md baseline, pull-requests.md, a coverage: check, full rspec, and sign Completed.
Round 1: reviewed PR 210, found 2 critical and 3 minor design findings, posted the comment and signed Completed (rejected 1/2)
Next round: check that Config.parse validates via Config::Schema, that to_yaml writes every key, and that the just update-config-schema recipe exists
Second design review of PR 210: code unchanged, so F201 and F202 stand as critical. Commented and signed Completed (rejected 2/2), which sends the plan to the arbitrator
The signature went in with --round 1 as the invocation instructed; the ledger already holds earlier rounds
Round 3 design review of PR 210: code unchanged, F201 and F202 stand as critical. Commented and signed Completed (rejected 3/2), past the cap, so the plan is for the arbitrator
Two earlier rejected rounds existed (20:33 and 22:03), so the K+1/M formula gave 3/2. If the arbitrator rules, F201 and F202 are the only blockers
Round 1 verdict rejected 1/2: F1 critical, Config.parse and to_yaml do not use the schema (How-to-test items 2 and 3 unmet)
Posted PR #210 comment 6844083710 with F1 (critical), F2 (tautological spec) and F3 (start reads worktree config before chdir)
alock refused pull-requests.md, held by openlanes:43808 (the plan dir/**), so my findings are not in pull-requests.md. Write them there next round if the lock is free
Rerun of round 1: PR #210 head unchanged at 30537b23 (local worktree HEAD is 56140912, unpushed), so I kept the verdict and posted no second comment
Copy F1-F3 from PR comment 6844083710 into pull-requests.md under ## Findings: staff-reviewer once the plan folder lock (held by the openlanes harness) is free
Third run of round 1: PR head still 30537b23 and the packet diff matches it, so the verdict stands at rejected 1/2 and I posted no new comment
alock refused pull-requests.md a third time: the harness pid (30962) holds the plan folder under the intent 'design-reviewer on 057.00'. A person has to fix how the harness takes this lock

backend-coder.next_step: U3: in config.rb derive KEYS/*_KEYS from Config::Schema (keep KEYS order: schema puts commands last, today's KEYS has it after merge, so reorder schema properties or keep message order), run Schema.errors after the hand checks and map data_pointer/type into '<path>: <key>: <problem>' shape; add just update-config-schema recipe (ruby -Ilib -e 'require "openlanes"; OpenLanes::Config::Schema.write'); then U4 to_yaml every key from Schema.defaults, then U6 integration spec
